points.description: Correct final answer x = 9, reached through valid steps: log2(2x−2)=2²=4, so 2x−2=2⁴=16, so x=9. Equivalent methods earn the mark. A single invalid step or a wrong final answer earns 0.

rubric.notes: Full mark (1) only for x = 9 with valid working. Any wrong step or wrong final answer earns 0. There is no partial credit.
